mapper.sql: select s.stock_id, s.store_id, s.book_id, s.location_id, s.qty_available, s.qty_locked, s.qty_borrowed, s.qty_damaged, s.safety_qty, s.version, s.create_time, s.update_time, b.isbn as book_isbn, b.title as book_title, c.category_name as category_name, l.location_code as location_code, l.location_name as location_name from biz_stock s left join biz_book b on b.book_id = s.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id left join biz_location l on l.location_id = s.location_id
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(case when warning_type = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as refill, ifnull(sum(case when warning_type = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as slowMoving, ifnull(sum(case when warning_type = 3 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as nearExpiry, ifnull(sum(case when warning_type = 4 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as zeroStock from biz_stock_warning where handle_status = 1

select s.location_id as locationId, l.location_code as locationCode, l.location_name as locationName, l.zone as zone, s.qty_available as qtyAvailable, s.qty_locked as qtyLocked, s.qty_borrowed as qtyBorrowed, s.qty_damaged as qtyDamaged from biz_stock s left join biz_location l on l.location_id = s.location_id where s.book_id = #{bookId} order by s.qty_available desc, s.location_id asc
mapper.update: update biz_stock set qty_available = qty_available - 1, qty_borrowed = qty_borrowed + 1, update_time = now() where stock_id = #{stockId} and qty_available >= 1
update biz_stock set qty_borrowed = qty_borrowed - 1, qty_available = qty_available + 1, update_time = now() where stock_id = #{stockId} and qty_borrowed >= 1
